title: Harbour crane collapses at north quay

metadata.title: Harbour crane collapses at north quay
metadata.description: A gantry crane at the north quay gave way shortly after 6am. Port operations are suspended until Thursday.
metadata.author: Ruth Ellinger

openGraph.title: Harbour crane collapses at north quay
